bootstrap_method: Participant-cluster percentile bootstrap; same participant draws for model comparisons; repeated rows travel together and each drawn cluster occurrence has total metric weight one. No-positive AP and one-class ROC undefined; undefined denominators omitted metric-by-metric with counts.
recency_definition: Observed raw last-cigarette recency: recent >30 and <=365.25 approximate days; longer >365.25; missing unknown, never zero. Additional recent sensitivity excludes prespecified raw rounded-boundary reports.
policy: Freeze snapshots/code/config before test answer access; evaluate once without fitting or threshold changes. Completed retries use saved results. Partial exposed runs stop for documented investigation, never silent reevaluation. Baseline comparison is descriptive, not model reselection. Timing C: classifier metrics only.
